titel: Design and Validation of a Robotic Knee Exoskeleton with Musculoskeletal Simulation-Derived Biological Torque Control
text: Data-driven controllers have enabled lower-limb robotic exoskeletons to adapt assistance to the user across many tasks. A leading example is biological torque control, which estimates the user's own joint moment from onboard sensors and assists in proportion to that estimate. However, its estimators are trained on data recorded with the target device, so deploying the controller on new hardware requires collecting new data. Existing open-source efforts release hardware, software, or controllers separately, so this data collection must still be repeated on the assembled device. Here, we present
was: Robotische Knie-Exoskelett-Forschung: Steuerung, die die Gelenkkraft des Nutzers aus Sensordaten schätzt und proportional unterstützt. Der Eintrag ist abgeschnitten.
berryroad: Kein Bezug zur Fertigung oder zu Automatisierungsplanung. Für Berryroad ohne Relevanz.

titel: SketchMate: Agentic Geometric Reasoning for Zero-Shot Precision Insertion
text: Inserting an unseen part requires sub-millimetre precision and the correct orientation of keyed features. Current zero-shot agentic manipulation methods built on vision-language models (VLMs) produce spatial outputs that are far too coarse for this. We propose to let a VLM build a sketch model of the task, i.e., a few geometric primitives and two mate frames, which a VLM agent measures with geometric tools in multi-view depth and which a standard planner and compliant controller execute. Because a sketch describes the parts independently of their placement, the robot needs to build it only onc
was: Forschungsarbeit zu VLM-gestützter Präzisionsmontage: Ein Vision-Language-Modell erstellt ein Skizzenmodell der Fügeaufgabe, das mit Geometriewerkzeugen vermessen und mit Standardplanung und nachgiebiger Regelung ausgeführt wird. Der Eintrag ist abgeschnitten.
berryroad: Berührt Präzisionsfügen und Zero-Shot-Manipulation, also Themen rund um Physical AI. Die Reife ist nur Labor-Niveau und der Eintrag belegt keine Ergebnisse im Mittelstand.

titel: Pinching Antennas for ISAC: Waveguide Architectures, Solutions, and Future Directions
text: Integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) is a core design principle for sixth-generation (6G) wireless systems, yet fixed antenna geometry limits its performance. Pinching antenna systems (PASS) guide electromagnetic waves along dielectric waveguides and radiate them through position-adaptive antennas, allowing communication links and sensing observations to benefit from spatial reconfiguration. This article reviews PASS-enabled ISAC through single-waveguide, multi-waveguide, and segmented-waveguide architectures, comparing their feed structures, spatial degrees of freedom, operating protoc
was: Übersichtsartikel zu Pinching Antennas für integrierte Sensorik und Kommunikation in 6G-Systemen.
berryroad: Telekommunikation ohne Bezug zur Fertigungsautomatisierung. Nicht relevant.

titel: When the Past Shapes Action: Understanding Embodied Memory
text: Recent advances in generative foundation models have expanded the capabilities of embodied AI, enabling increasingly general navigation, manipulation, and long-horizon task execution. However, effective interaction with dynamic environments requires more than only strong perception and reasoning: agents must act with partial knowledge and retain, retrieve, and update information from past observations, actions, and experiences. This survey examines embodied memory as a mechanism for preserving decision-relevant information beyond the current observation. We organize existing approaches along t
was: Übersichtsarbeit zu Embodied Memory, also dem Speichern und Abrufen vergangener Beobachtungen bei verkörperten KI-Agenten.
berryroad: Allgemeine Grundlagenforschung zu Robotern ohne Fertigungsbezug. Für Berryroad höchstens Hintergrundwissen.

titel: Learning from Physical Experience:Context-Space Adaptation for Robotic Manipulation
text: Recent multimodal foundation models exhibit strong perception, reasoning, and in-context learning capabilities, but translating these capabilities into physical action remains challenging. Through real-world experiments across diverse manipulation tasks, we find that ChatGPT-6-Astra, a state-of-the-art general-purpose reasoner, can serve as a physically actionable, context-responsive manipulation policy, demonstrating effective fine manipulation and spatial reasoning. Building on these findings, we introduce LEXP, a harness for learning from physical experience through context-space adaptation
was: Arbeit zu LEXP, einem Ansatz, bei dem ein allgemeines Sprachmodell über Kontextanpassung aus physischer Erfahrung lernt und Manipulationsaufgaben ausführt. Die Ergebnisse stammen aus Einzelexperimenten.
berryroad: Die Praxistauglichkeit für wiederholbare Industrieprozesse ist nicht belegt. Der Ansatz ist eher ein Signal für Foundation-Model-Robotik als für ein Angebot.

titel: STAR: Steering Action Representations during Inference
text: Vision-language-action models (VLAs) map language instructions and visual observations to robot actions, showing strong capabilities across robotic manipulation tasks. However, in our probing experiment, we find that action representations near the action output do not fully preserve task-relevant visual grounding. Motivated by this late-layer grounding gap, we introduce STAR, for STeering Action Representations, a training-free inference method for pre-trained VLAs. STAR applies an exponential moving average over late-layer residual updates, allowing later action representations to inherit ob
was: STAR ist ein trainingsfreies Verfahren, das die Aktionsrepräsentationen bestehender Vision-Language-Action-Modelle zur Laufzeit glättet.
berryroad: Methodische Detailverbesserung für VLA-Modelle ohne Bezug zu Planung oder Wirtschaftlichkeit im Mittelstand. Für Berryroad nicht handlungsrelevant.

titel: From Teleoperation to Long-Horizon Dexterity: Evaluating Visuomotor Skills and Offline Proxies for Dexterous Manipulation
text: Imitation learning policies are intended to make robotic manipulation robust to variations in object pose, appearance, and environment that challenge pre-programmed motion. However, real-world performance remains difficult to predict, as conventional optimization signals such as validation loss show no consistent relationship with robot success. To identify the design choices that govern real-world performance, 281 imitation-learning policies spanning seven policy families were evaluated in approximately 1,700 real-robot trials of RJ45 connector grasping and insertion using a five-fingered rob
was: Studie mit 281 Imitation-Learning-Policies und rund 1.700 Roboterversuchen zum Greifen und Stecken von RJ45-Steckern mit fünffingriger Hand.
berryroad: Der Befund, dass Validierungsverlust kaum etwas über den Robotererfolg aussagt, ist für die Abnahme lernender Systeme relevant. Der Anwendungsfall ist aber sehr speziell.

titel: CaPtain: A Pipeline for Post-Training Code-as-Policy Robot Agents
text: Across coding, web, and tool-use tasks, language-model agents are now routinely trained with the same recipe: supervised fine-tuning (SFT) to learn the interface, then multi-turn reinforcement learning (RL) to master it. Code-as-policy (CaP) casts robot manipulation in the same form, as the policy writes code against robot APIs and reads back the results, so the same recipe should apply. Yet existing CaP agents sidestep training: they either prompt closed frontier models or delegate manipulation to pre-trained vision-language-action models (VLAs) and high-level skills, while small open vision-
was: CaPtain ist eine Pipeline, mit der kleine Sprachmodelle als Code-Policy-Agenten für Roboter per SFT und Reinforcement Learning trainiert werden.
berryroad: Forschungsansatz ohne Industriebezug. Für Berryroad derzeit nicht verwertbar.
